svg.title: Textual-side and visual-side distillation pipeline
svg.desc: Inventory and layout: the figure is a two-panel training diagram. The left beige rounded dashed frame is the Textual Side with two rows D1 and D2 under a vertical T1/D1/D2/D axis. Each row contains labels, a TA-prompt parallelogram, prompt stack, text encoder stack, text features, auxiliary qT/qS triangle icons, Fixed-T/EMA-T bars, loss boxes, arrows, and fire/snow icons. The center contains ID-logits text, red grid logits, circular junction nodes and vertical dashed arrows. The right pale-green rounded dashed frame is the Visual Side with image features, VA-prompt pool bars, image encoder stacks, person image stacks, EMA-T and loss boxes; two inner rounded dashed distillation frames contain VA-Prompt/Image Encoder/Images and LID/Ltriplet labels. The bottom contains legends for current text features and current image features plus textual/visual side labels. Symmetry basis: top and bottom training rows mirror each other horizontally; textual and visual sides are separated by a central ID-logits column and joined by bidirectional arrows.
